en.headline: Taxi driver dies after three-vehicle crash on Lantau’s Cheung Tung Road
en.dek: A taxi, a Discovery Bay bus and a goods vehicle collided near Sunny Bay around 8 p.m.; the taxi driver later died of his injuries and more than ten people were hurt.
body: A three-vehicle collision on Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay on Lantau left a taxi driver dead and more than ten people injured on Tuesday evening.

The Transport Department said the crash occurred at about 8 p.m. and involved a taxi, a single-deck Discovery Bay bus on route DB03P travelling from Discovery Bay towards Sunny Bay Station, and a medium goods vehicle. The taxi and bus collided head-on; the taxi’s front and rear were heavily damaged, with one rear wheel detached, while the bus sustained damage to its right side and windscreen.

According to multiple reports, the taxi driver was trapped and unconscious at the scene and was later confirmed to have died of his injuries after being taken to North Lantau Hospital. A passenger in the taxi was also seriously hurt, while eight to nine people on the bus and the goods-vehicle driver sustained lesser injuries. Casualties were taken to North Lantau and Princess Margaret hospitals.

Both directions of Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay were closed, together with the slow lane of North Lantau Highway towards the airport. Drivers were advised to use the remaining lanes and to expect congestion. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山翔東路三車相撞 的士司機傷重不治
zh.dek: 晚上約八時翔東路近欣澳發生涉及的士、愉景灣巴士及貨車的車禍，的士司機其後傷重不治，逾十人受傷。
body: 北大嶼山翔東路近欣澳周二晚發生三車相撞交通意外，一名的士司機傷重不治，逾十人受傷。
運輸署表示，意外約於晚上八時發生，涉及一輛的士、一輛行走DB03P線由愉景灣往欣澳站的單層巴士，以及一輛中型貨車。的士與巴士迎頭相撞，的士車頭及車尾嚴重損毀，左尾輪飛脫；巴士右邊車身及擋風玻璃受損。
多份報道指，的士司機被困並陷入昏迷，送往北大嶼山醫院後證實傷重不治。的士上一名乘客亦受重傷，巴士上八至九人及貨車司機則受輕傷，傷者分送北大嶼山醫院及瑪嘉烈醫院治理。
翔東路近欣澳來回全線及北大嶼山公路往機場方向慢線一度封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線，現場交通繁忙。警方正調查意外原因。
